assertions.text: States gh pr view --json state,mergeCommit is checked regardless of the merge command's exit code
States git ls-remote --heads origin <headRefName> always runs when merge_auto_delete_branch is true and isCrossRepository is false, even after a clean exit-0 merge
On non-empty ls-remote output, states it completes deletion via gh api -X DELETE repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/refs/heads/<branch>
